description: Searches Unsplash stock photos (landscape) for covers. Use when the user wants a cover or background image for a workout, program or exercise and has no image of their own. Not for saving a photo to the team (use import_image). Returns photo IDs, thumbnails and photographer names; pass a photo ID to import_image.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Defaults to 1.

per_page.description: Results per page, 1 to 30. Defaults to 10.

search_text.description: What the photo should show, e.g. "yoga sunrise" or "kettlebell gym".

name: search_stock_images
title: Search stock images
